main_issue: Whether and when Agent D can cook strong-smelling fish curry in the shared flat, given the smell affects A's work calls, B's room and C's laundry

A-B.evidence: B said A's evening timing 'doesn't really help with my room' (8), but B accepted D's heads-up arrangement (10) and A endorsed the Tue/Thu after 7 plan (19).

A-C.evidence: Both complained about smell (1, 3); C agreed to Tue/Thu (18) and A endorsed 'Tuesdays and Thursdays after 7' (19).

A-D.evidence: A asked for no strong-smelling food (opening); D defended it (4). D accepted weekends/after-7 timing (6); A: 'Tuesdays and Thursdays after 7. That works for me' (19); D: 'Okay' (22).

B-C.evidence: They never addressed each other; both complained about smell (2, 3) and both ended up accepting D's arrangements (10, 18).

B-D.evidence: B asked D to let B know before cooking so B can close the door (8); D: 'Okay, sure. I can let you know' (9); B: 'thanks' (10).

C-D.evidence: C objected that the smell would still hit laundry (11); D proposed Tue/Thu curry (17); C: 'Okay, that works' (18).
